en.meta.description: Animated terminal pet & custom statusline for Antigravity CLI (agy). Watch Maggy dance beside your live model, context & quota usage bars, and git branch.
en.meta.ogDescription: Animated terminal pet & custom statusline for Antigravity CLI (agy) — a dancing mascot with live model, context & quota usage bars, reasoning effort, and git branch.
en.hero.title: Maggy 🌋 lives in your agy statusline.
en.hero.lede: An animated terminal pet and custom Antigravity CLI (agy) statusline. Maggy dances while agy works, stomps through tool calls, and dozes off when you step away — right beside your live model, context window, quota usage bars, reasoning effort, and git branch.
en.hero.hint: macOS or Linux, Python 3, a truecolor terminal. Other ways to install
en.hero.spriteAria: Maggy, the Antigravity logo with eyes, dancing
en.states.note: agy redraws the statusline only when something changes, never on a timer. While idle Maggy holds one pose and only her sparkles twinkle (via the terminal's blink attribute). Click idle again to simulate the next redraw.
en.try.title: Customize your agy statusline
en.try.desc: This is the statusline agy draws under your prompt. Maggy sits to the left of your model, context usage, color-coded quota bars, workspace, and git branch — every frame is the same width, so nothing beside her ever shifts. Change a setting below to see the command that does it.
en.try.terminalAria: Preview of the agy statusline with Maggy
en.try.note: auto picks seasonal looks by date (see Themes below). Idle twinkle uses the terminal's blink attribute, so sparkles keep moving even when agy stops redrawing.
en.themes.title: Seasonal & custom themes
en.themes.desc: By default, auto dresses Maggy up on holidays and switches back the next day. Pick any card below to preview it live, lock a theme anytime with maggy theme <name>, or add your own JSON theme.
en.themes.default.desc: The classic Antigravity logo colors and warm golden sparkles.
en.themes.xmas.desc: Santa hat with pom-pom, falling snow, arch lights and a little tree.
en.themes.halloween.desc: Witch-purple hat, glowing eyes and a flickering jack-o'-lantern.
en.themes.cny.desc: Gold crown, falling confetti and a red lantern with a swaying tassel.
en.themes.custom.title: Make your own theme
en.themes.custom.desc: Drop a JSON file into ~/.config/maggy/themes/ and its filename becomes the theme name (e.g. paddy.json → maggy theme paddy). Recolor regions or cells, swap sparkles, draw your own prop beside Maggy (like the tree or lantern), or start from a built-in look with base. Set dates so auto activates it automatically, and run maggy theme list to see all installed themes.
en.install.title: Install Maggy for Antigravity CLI
en.install.desc: maggy setup points statusLine in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json at Maggy. Your other settings stay as they are, and the old file is saved as settings.json.bak.
en.install.restart: Restart agy, or run /statusline enable inside it.
en.install.brew.note: Upgrade with brew upgrade maggy. Shell completions for bash, zsh and fish come with it.
en.install.curl.step1: Run the installer. It clones to ~/.maggy, links maggy into ~/.local/bin and runs maggy setup.
en.install.curl.note: Pass setup options with | bash -s -- --theme xmas --no-mood. Update later with maggy update.
en.commands.title: CLI commands
en.commands.desc: Everything goes through one command. Run maggy help for the full list.
en.commands.status: Shows whether Maggy is hooked up, your theme and settings, and a sample of her.
en.commands.preview: Plays any agent_state in your terminal without starting an agent turn.
en.commands.disable: Hides the statusline without removing it. statusline on brings it back.
en.commands.pet: Hides the logo and keeps the metrics. motion off holds a still pose instead, and side right moves her to the right. Each takes toggle.
en.commands.hide: Leaves segments out: model, context, quota, workspace, git, effort. maggy statusline show brings them back.
en.commands.doctor: Checks Python, truecolor support, the settings file, and how fast a frame renders.
en.commands.config: Shows ~/.config/maggy/config.json. Use get, set or reset to change it.
en.commands.uninstall: Removes the statusLine entry, config and cache. Your other agy settings stay.

en.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
en.faq.desc: Common questions about installing, customizing, and troubleshooting the Maggy statusline for Antigravity CLI.
en.faq.q1: How do I show context window and quota usage in Antigravity CLI (agy)?
en.faq.a1: Install Maggy with brew install agy-pet/tap/maggy && maggy setup and restart agy or run /statusline enable. Maggy hooks into statusLine in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json and displays your live model, context window %, color-coded quota bars, workspace, git branch, and reasoning effort alongside the mascot.
en.faq.q2: Why isn't the statusline showing after maggy setup?
en.faq.a2: Restart agy or run /statusline enable inside an active session. If it still doesn't appear, run maggy doctor to verify Python 3, truecolor terminal support, and the statusLine entry in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json.
en.faq.q3: Does Maggy slow down agy or send any telemetry?
en.faq.a3: No. The maggy CLI runs 100% locally using only the Python 3 standard library and sends zero telemetry. agy only invokes it when state changes (never on a background timer), and you can check render speed anytime with maggy doctor.
en.faq.q4: Can I hide the mascot or customize which statusline segments appear?
en.faq.a4: Yes. Run maggy pet off to keep only the metrics, maggy motion off for a still pose, or maggy side right to move Maggy to the right. Hide individual segments with maggy statusline hide (model, context, quota, workspace, git, effort) and restore them with maggy statusline show.
en.faq.q5: What platforms and terminals are supported?
en.faq.a5: Maggy works on macOS and Linux (including WSL) in any truecolor (24-bit) terminal such as Ghostty, Kitty, iTerm2, WezTerm, Alacritty, Warp, or VS Code's integrated terminal, and requires Python 3.

zh-CN.faq.q1: 如何在 Antigravity CLI (agy) 中显示上下文窗口和配额使用条？

ja.faq.title: よくある質問
ja.faq.desc: Antigravity CLI 向けステータスライン Maggy のインストール・カスタマイズ・トラブルシューティング。
ja.faq.q1: Antigravity CLI (agy) でコンテキスト使用率やクォータ残量バーを表示するには？
ja.faq.a1: brew install agy-pet/tap/maggy && maggy setup でインストール後、agy を再起動するか /statusline enable を実行してください。~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json の statusLine に登録され、マスコットの横にモデル、コンテキスト使用率、色分けされたクォータバー、ワークスペース、Git ブランチ、推論レベルが表示されます。
ja.faq.q2: maggy setup 後にステータスラインが表示されない場合は？
ja.faq.a2: agy を再起動するか、セッション内で /statusline enable を実行してください。それでも表示されない場合は maggy doctor を実行し、Python 3・トゥルーカラー対応・~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json の statusLine 設定を確認してください。
ja.faq.q3: Maggy は agy の動作を重くしたり、テレメトリを送信したりしますか？
ja.faq.a3: いいえ。maggy CLI は Python 3 標準ライブラリのみで完全ローカル動作し、テレメトリは一切送信しません。agy が状態変化時のみ呼び出す仕組み（バックグラウンドタイマーなし）で、描画速度はいつでも maggy doctor で計測できます。
ja.faq.q4: マスコットを非表示にしたり、表示する項目をカスタマイズできますか？
ja.faq.a4: はい。maggy pet off でメトリクスのみ表示、maggy motion off で静止表示、maggy side right で右側配置に変更できます。maggy statusline hide で個別項目（model・context・quota・workspace・git・effort）を隠し、maggy statusline show で戻せます。
ja.faq.q5: 対応している OS とターミナルは？
ja.faq.a5: Python 3 が動作する macOS および Linux（WSL を含む）に対応しています。Ghostty、Kitty、iTerm2、WezTerm、Alacritty、Warp、VS Code 統合ターミナルなど、24-bit トゥルーカラー対応のターミナルで利用できます。

ko.faq.a1: brew install agy-pet/tap/maggy && maggy setup으로 설치한 뒤 agy를 재시작하거나 /statusline enable을 실행하세요. ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json의 statusLine에 연결되어 마스코트 옆에 현재 모델, 컨텍스트 비율, 색상별 할당량 바, 워크스페이스, Git 브랜치, 추론 강도가 표시됩니다.

pt.faq.title: Perguntas frequentes
pt.faq.desc: Dúvidas comuns sobre instalação, personalização e solução de problemas da barra de status Maggy para Antigravity CLI.
pt.faq.q1: Como mostrar a janela de contexto e o uso de cota na Antigravity CLI (agy)?
pt.faq.a1: Instale a Maggy com brew install agy-pet/tap/maggy && maggy setup e reinicie o agy ou execute /statusline enable. A Maggy configura statusLine em ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json e exibe o modelo atual, % de contexto, barras de cota coloridas, workspace, branch do git e esforço de raciocínio ao lado da mascote.
pt.faq.q2: Por que a barra de status não aparece após o maggy setup?
pt.faq.a2: Reinicie o agy ou execute /statusline enable em uma sessão ativa. Se ainda não aparecer, rode maggy doctor para verificar o Python 3, o suporte a truecolor no terminal e a entrada statusLine em ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json.
pt.faq.q3: A Maggy deixa o agy mais lento ou envia telemetria?
pt.faq.a3: Não. A CLI da maggy roda 100% localmente usando apenas a biblioteca padrão do Python 3 e envia zero telemetria. O agy só a chama quando o estado muda (sem timer em segundo plano) e você pode checar a velocidade de renderização com maggy doctor.
pt.faq.q4: Posso ocultar a mascote ou escolher quais segmentos exibir?
pt.faq.a4: Sim. Execute maggy pet off para manter apenas as métricas, maggy motion off para pose fixa ou maggy side right para mover a Maggy para a direita. Oculte segmentos com maggy statusline hide (model, context, quota, workspace, git, effort) e restaure com maggy statusline show.
pt.faq.q5: Quais plataformas e terminais são suportados?
pt.faq.a5: A Maggy funciona no macOS e Linux (incluindo WSL) em qualquer terminal truecolor (24 bits) como Ghostty, Kitty, iTerm2, WezTerm, Alacritty, Warp ou o terminal integrado do VS Code, e requer Python 3.
